mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, account_id, protocol_account_id, online_attempt_id, previous_online_attempt_id, command_id, batch_id, proxy_id, source, from_state, to_state, diagnosis_code, diagnosis_class, raw_code, raw_reason, recoverability, action_taken, worker_id, evidence_json, occurred_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_online_attempt_log ( account_id, protocol_account_id, online_attempt_id, previous_online_attempt_id, command_id, batch_id, proxy_id, source, from_state, to_state, diagnosis_code, diagnosis_class, raw_code, raw_reason, recoverability, action_taken, worker_id, evidence_json, occurred_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{protocolAccountId}, #{onlineAttemptId}, #{previousOnlineAttemptId}, #{commandId}, #{batchId}, #{proxyId}, #{source}, #{fromState}, #{toState}, #{diagnosisCode}, #{diagnosisClass}, #{rawCode}, #{rawReason}, #{recoverability}, #{actionTaken}, #{workerId}, #{evidenceJson}, #{occurredAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT online_attempt_id FROM account_online_attempt_log WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM account_online_attempt_log WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND to_state = 'PROXY_FAILED' AND occurred_at = #{occurredAt} ORDER BY CASE WHEN diagnosis_class = 'STATE_CHANGED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC LIMIT 1
